title: Executive at Global Logistics Firm Expects Samsara Business to Grow 3%–5% in 2026 and Gain Share
expert: CIO and chief supply chain officer at a global logistics firm that is a Samsara customer and reseller (carriers of 275–500 vehicles)
verdict: Samsara business through the firm grew 10%–12% y/y in Aug–Oct, but renewal spend fell 10% on multi-solution and 5% on single-solution deals as customers buy fewer modules.

Enterprise expansion ($100K+ cohort): 🔴 Renewal spend down 10% (multi-solution) and 5% (single) (estimate), vs 2026-11-06 MSP director (+15%–25%): conflicting; matches Jefferies license-cost scrutiny (SB #62601). → Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion) ↓
GM/FCF through component cycle: 🟢 3-year contracts with 3%–6% escalators; 360° camera $560 vs $200 dual-camera buy-in, vs 2026-11-09 consultant +3%–5%: in line. → Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost) ↑
Competition & share: 🟢 At least 15%–20% share gain in 2026 (estimate), Platform Science 'lost the market'; Motive gaining faster than Geotab and Verizon; vs 2026-11-09 consultant (modest share gains): more bullish. → Tenet 4 (platform moat) ↑

characterization_changed: Characterization changed from Positive: renewal spend is down 5%–10% and the 2026 outlook is only +3%–5%, offsetting a 10%–12% Aug–Oct quarter.
changes: Renewal spend: down 5%–10% vs 2026-11-06 MSP director +15%–25%: conflicting; vs Jefferies license-cost scrutiny (SB #62601): confirming.
Growth outlook: CY26 +3%–5% vs 2026-11-06 VP +8%–11%: lower.
Share: at least 15%–20% gain (estimate) vs 2026-11-09 consultant's modest share gains: more bullish.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion): ↓ — renewal spend down 5%–10% as customers buy fewer modules.
Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost): ↑ — 3%–6% escalators; 360° camera $560.
Tenet 4 (platform moat): ↑ — share gain of at least 15%–20% (estimate).
